long_biography.plain_text:
After studying finance at the University of Pennsylvania, Sadıoğlu joined Kapital at its formation in 1992. He worked alongside family co-founders, helping lead a receivables-finance company serving Turkish businesses. Over three decades, he moved from early management into deputy chairmanship while the group developed risk systems, broadened funding through bond markets and built a substantial equity base.

Sadıoğlu also served as a senior leader of Kapital Gayrimenkul, contributing to an Istanbul office portfolio. His disclosed stake in the factoring company later became its largest individual holding. In 2026, Kapital acquired another regulated factoring company, installed Sadıoğlu as chairman and general manager, and renamed the subsidiary K2 Faktoring. The combination leaves his principal business identity in non-bank finance, with commercial property as a longstanding parallel activity.
